record.question: Identify the parts of speech of the underlined word 'on' in: Let us move on.
record.explanation: Answer A: Adverb. In “move on,” on modifies the verb move and has no object; it is an adverb. Independent check: “On” functions as a particle/adverb in the phrasal verb “move on,” with no object after it. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/prepositions-and-particles. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
